title: Package the three styles as a standalone Claude Code plugin
description: Prepare this repo for the opum marketplace as its own plugin. History: opum-doc first ruled a fold-in to opum-output-styles 0.2.0; the owner reversed that on 2026-10-06 and chose to keep plain-english-styles and opum-output-styles separate. This task adds .claude-plugin/plugin.json and moves the styles to output-styles/; the marketplace entry and the v0.1.0 tag follow through the marketplace owner.

acceptanceCriteria.text: claude plugin validate exits 0 on the repo root
The three style files live under output-styles/ with their frontmatter names unchanged
A session started with the repo loaded as a plugin loads all three styles under the plain-english-styles: namespace
harness/config/contracts.json and harness tests point at the new paths and the harness test suite passes
README and the install runbook document the plugin install and the namespaced outputStyle value, keeping the manual copy path

finalSummary:
Added .claude-plugin/plugin.json (plain-english-styles 0.1.0) and moved the three styles into output-styles/ with names unchanged; harness contracts and test repointed; README and install runbook document the plugin install and the namespaced outputStyle value alongside the hand-copy path. Verified on commit 9b9d2ae (no CI configured in this repo): claude plugin validate exits 0 (one expected warning: root CLAUDE.md is not shipped context); harness npm test 245/245 pass and cli audit 'all 12 checks agree'; canary under --plugin-dir: all three 'plain-english-styles:Plain English - <level>' names obeyed the canary, while the em-dash name and the bare un-namespaced name both fell back to Default silently. Not done here, by instruction from opum-agent: no tag, no marketplace PR; standalone vs fold-into-opum-output-styles is pending with the operator's design session.

Re-scoped after the fold-in ruling: plugin.json removed from this repo; README and runbook now point at opum-output-styles and its opum-output-styles:<name> values. Draft opum-output-styles 0.2.0 (scratch clone, commit ababae1 on its dev 87b427c, exported as a patch) adds the three files, bumps to 0.2.0, carries the Jeremy Newhouse MIT notice, and replaces the README 'nothing copied' note with a provenance section, because jeremy-newhouse/claude-output-styles redirects to this repo. Verified: claude plugin validate passes on the draft; canary loads all four opum-output-styles:<name> styles incl. Show Your Checks, and the old plain-english-styles: name falls back to Default. Harness re-run on the re-scoped tree: 245/245 pass, audit all 12 checks agree. Landing and tag v0.2.0 belong to the marketplace worker.

Reversed to standalone by the owner (2026-10-06): plugin.json and the plain-english-styles docs restored byte-for-byte from 9b9d2ae; the opum-output-styles 0.2.0 draft is dropped and opum-output-styles is untouched. Re-verified on the restored tree: claude plugin validate passes (CLAUDE.md warning only); canary loads plain-english-styles:Plain English - Beginner/Intermediate/Advanced, bare name falls back to Default; lore check clean; harness files unchanged since the 245/245 run.
